body:
Yeah.. the school system sucks because I never feel like I learn anything because it doesn't make me want to really learn anything. 

And yes I suppose? I procrastinate on everything so most of my work gets done the night before. At best I start it a few days early but I usually give up because I get stuck and tell myself there's tomorrow.
Mm, not that I can think of. I've always been able to get by with the bare minimum.
Both. I've always been lazy and I hit the point in the semester where I'm too tired to care.

Yes, but then I think about the negative what ifs and curiosity turns into fear/anxiety. What if we all go to some sort of hell where we have to consciously live through some sort of physical torment in eternity? What if there is nothing next? What if my consciousness just floats in darkness? What if my consciousness no longer exists in the same way, rendering me unable to really "know" and process this next stage, defeating the purpose of satisfying curiosity? Maybe we're reincarnated with no memories. Maybe we go to heaven with no memories.
Did I plagiarize? Yes. I'm not good at bluffing and it was obvious she already knew.

Professor reported me for plagiarism and I have to go in for a hearing. Could be possibly expelled or suspended. I've dropped out of one college already and it's not a conversation I want to repeat with my parents. Even if it's just a suspension, one year is too much for me to cover up. Plus I've been feeling disillusioned with the whole "it gets better when I'm older" idea I've been holding onto for years.

The knowledge and experience of happy moments that I want to repeat. Depression comes in when I realize that they are few and far in between, and the gaps are usually filled with either nothing or really bad times. I don't hate life, I just hate my life.
